title: CRAFT: Forgetting-Aware Intervention-Based Adaptation for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.05732v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can learn new tasks through fine-tuning, but learning tasks sequentially often leads to catastrophic forgetting of earlier ones. This paper proposes CRAFT, a continual learning framework that keeps model weights frozen and instead learns low-rank interventions on hidden representations. Similar tasks share an intervention to help knowledge transfer, with similarity judged by how each task alters the model's output distribution rather than by a learned gating network. Within a shared intervention, a Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty keeps each new task close to the intervention's existing behavior, which limits forgetting of earlier tasks, while a small, task-private intervention in the deepest layers preserves dedicated capacity that later tasks cannot overwrite. translated_title: CRAFT：面向持续学习的遗忘感知干预式适应方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过微调学习新任务，但按顺序学习多个任务往往会导致对先前任务的灾难性遗忘。本文提出了CRAFT，这是一种持续学习框架，它保持模型权重冻结，转而学习对隐藏表示的低秩干预。相似的任务共享同一个干预以促进知识迁移，其中相似性通过每个任务如何改变模型的输出分布来判断，而不是通过学习到的门控网络来判断。在共享干预内部，Kullback-Leibler（KL）惩罚使每个新任务保持接近该干预的既有行为，从而限制对较早任务的遗忘；同时，在最深层中引入一个小型的任务私有干预，保留了后续任务无法覆盖的专属容量。所学到的干预还使得在测试时能够识别任务，因此不需要任务身份标签。在多个基准……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: CRAFT提出了一种冻结大模型权重、通过学习低秩隐藏表示干预实现持续学习的框架，利用基于输出分布的任务相似性共享干预、KL惩罚以及深层任务私有干预来缓解灾难性遗忘，且在测试时无需任务身份标签即可自动识别任务。
en_tdlr: CRAFT is a continual learning framework that freezes LLM weights and learns low-rank interventions on hidden representations, using output-distribution-based task similarity, KL penalties, and task-private deep-layer interventions to mitigate catastrophic forgetting without requiring task identity labels at test time.
